answer_1.quote: Plain language summaries of scientific information are important ... generative models have made gains in translating scientific information into plain language approachable to lay audiences.
answer_1.outputs: plain language summaries (candidate summaries and perturbed variants)

answer_2.quote: We compute the following 8 automated metrics: • Overlap-based metrics measure n-gram overlap. We report ROUGE, BLEU, METEOR, and SARI. • Model-based metrics use pretrained models: GPT-PPL, BERTScore, and LENS. • QA-based metrics capture content quality: QAEval.

answer_3.quote: We adopt the prompt template ... to have GPT-4 (gpt-4-0613) evaluate each candidate summary on the four PLS criteria and to provide an overall quality score.

answer_4.quote: We sample 100 pairs... Annotators were asked to assess content alignment ... and rate informativeness, simplification, faithfulness, and coherence on 5-point Likert scales.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each criterion (informativeness, simplification, faithfulness, coherence) on a 5-point Likert scale (1=worst, 5=best).
